read_statements: CALL dbms.components() YIELD name, versions, edition RETURN name, versions, edition
MATCH (n) WHERE n.bimbaCoordinate IS NOT NULL RETURN id(n) AS exportLocalId, labels(n) AS labels, properties(n) AS properties ORDER BY exportLocalId

MATCH (n)-[r]->(m) WHERE n.bimbaCoordinate IS NOT NULL OR m.bimbaCoordinate IS NOT NULL RETURN id(r) AS exportLocalRelationId, id(n) AS sourceExportLocalId, n.bimbaCoordinate AS sourceCoordinate, labels(n) AS sourceLabels, properties(n) AS sourceProperties, type(r) AS relationType, properties(r) AS relationProperties, id(m) AS targetExportLocalId, m.bimbaCoordinate AS targetCoordinate, labels(m) AS targetLabels, properties(m) AS targetProperties ORDER BY exportLocalRelationId
